findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_daily, get_rates · Private data: get_series · Public sink: get_daily, get_rates · Destructive: get_rates, search_assets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_daily, get_rates · Private data: get_series · Public sink: get_daily, get_rates · Destructive: get_rates, search_assets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
